task_metadata.research_topic: Neural operators for industrial CFD design on 3D unstructured meshes
task_metadata.research_question: Can a custom neural operator outperform standard point cloud / graph / physics-attention baselines on aerodynamic design prediction?

tests.label: Car
tests.notes: ShapeNet-Car design benchmark, used in Transolver / Neural-Solver-Library DesignBench.

tests.label: AirfRANS
tests.notes: AirfRANS 2D airfoil RANS benchmark, used in Transolver / Neural-Solver-Library DesignBench.

tests.label: AirCraft
tests.notes: Custom 3D aircraft design dataset assembled for this task; no published baseline. Included as a held-out generalization probe; numbers are task-internal references, not literature reproductions.

baselines.name: pointnet
baselines.notes: PointNet (Qi et al., 2017). Reference n_hidden=16 per vendor/external_packages/Neural-Solver-Library/scripts/DesignBench/car/PointNet.sh; full max_block (n_hidden*32) preserved.

baselines.name: graphsage
baselines.notes: GraphSAGE (Hamilton et al., 2017). Reference n_hidden=128 per vendor/external_packages/Neural-Solver-Library/scripts/DesignBench/car/GraphSAGE.sh.

baselines.name: graphunet
baselines.notes: Graph U-Net (Gao & Ji, 2019). Reference n_hidden=16 per vendor/external_packages/Neural-Solver-Library/scripts/DesignBench/car/GraphUNet.sh.

baselines.name: gnot
baselines.notes: GNOT (Hao et al., 2023, MoE general neural operator transformer). Reference n_hidden=256 per vendor/external_packages/Neural-Solver-Library/scripts/DesignBench/car/GNOT.sh.

baselines.name: transolver
baselines.notes: Transolver (Wu et al., 2024). Reference n_hidden=256, slice_num=32 per vendor/external_packages/Neural-Solver-Library/scripts/DesignBench/car/Transolver.sh.
